reserveReview.rationale: The Accountable dashboard (ts 2026-10-27T14:46Z) reports $72,431,359.63 of reserves; the leaves below sum to that figure. Money Markets $52,852,347.25, Delta-Neutral Equity Arbitrage $6,710,521.17, Cash & Equivalents $7,439,149.43 (Bank Cash $100,180.99 plus FX Collateral $7,338,968.44, OTC & Exchange Reserve $0). On-chain Liquidity leaves: Ethereum USDC supplied to Morpho $2,190,549.56, idle USDC $714,534.09, USDT $207,477.74, AUSD $12,159.95, ETH $516.29; Monad AUSD - Morpho $2,304,098.39; Base ETH $5.77. AUSD is labeled by symbol only, so both AUSD leaves stay unlinked and unverified rather than assumed to be Agora AUSD. The issuer solvency endpoint corroborates the total (72,431,784.82 at 1793116861832, 15 minutes later). Custodian identities and the Morpho vaults remain undisclosed. Accountable data.liquidity (as_of 2026-10-27, complete true, unmapped_instruments 0) assigns the money_markets class time_to_cash Same day, so the keyed money-market sleeve keeps a one-day operational liquidity horizon; this does not assert a contractual redemption SLA.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Legal terms make reserves Tori BVI property rather than segregated client assets and deny purchasers a continuing claim in transferred collateral. Operational segregated-account marketing does not establish bankruptcy remoteness for trUSD holders. Reserve-custodian legal entities, asset-specific provider allocations, segregation agreements, rehypothecation rights, and exchange-vs-bank custody allocations are not publicly resolved. The historical cex custodyModel is retained pending reconciliation of chain tracing with current issuer/Accountable disclosures; Anchorage/BitGo/Cactus token-custody availability is not reserve custody.
